meta.run: September 2026 supplier payment run, Harbourline Studio Ltd
revisions: 1: first handoff to the scheduler (2 pay, 2 hold, 8 exclude).

2: principal answers received. R05: HOLD, it goes in the FX run on 7 October. R11: REJECT, closed (relayed by the extractor). R06: approved at 5,100.00 GBP net of CN-012, which conflicts with the bank feed (CN-012 refunded 10 Sep); moved from pay to hold and the principal asked to confirm 5,400.00 or 5,100.00.

meta.layout: One entry per document, R01 to R12, using the extractor's record ids. decision is pay, hold or exclude. amount_to_pay is the invoice gross in the invoice currency, set only where decision is pay and null otherwise. variance_net is document net minus PO net in the PO currency (positive means the invoice is above the PO), assessed only for valid invoices (R01, R05, R06, R08); voided, superseded and duplicate documents carry null. scheduling tells the scheduler what it may do: schedule_now, after_principal_approval or do_not_schedule. principal_approval_needed marks items reserved for the principal; principal_item records the question and the answer. Every payment goes to the supplier master details on file; no bank-detail change has been approved.
checks_done: Bank feed: opening 41,382.17 plus the seven movements equals the stated closing 46,440.98.
Every document with amounts: net plus VAT equals gross.
Sender domain matches the supplier master for every document except R11.
Only R06 is over the 2,000.00 GBP approval threshold. R05 is USD 960.00, well under 2,000.00 GBP at any plausible rate.

run_notes: PO variance accepted (policy 4): INV-000491 (R08, PO-1044). Invoice net 315.50 (business cards, 10 boxes, 150.00; letterheads, 2,000 sheets, 165.50 at 82.75 per thousand) against PO net 300.00 is +15.50 net (5.2%), within the 50.00 tolerance. The PO does not itemise, so the 15.50 cannot be tied to a line. Paid at the invoice amount, 378.60 GBP gross. The supplier's correction (R07 to R08) moved the letterheads from 160.50 to 165.50 net.
